entries.camera: Ground-level wide-angle shot with the lens resting in the ash, the sapling and the spirit in the lower third, the burnt forest receding behind.
entries.subject: A small fox-shaped fire spirit made entirely of flickering flame and glowing coals sits calmly in the middle of a burnt forest clearing. Between its front paws a single fresh green sapling pushes up through the black ash, lit by the spirit like a tiny lantern. Charred tree trunks stand all around, still marked with thin orange cracks of glowing heat, and drifting embers rise into a smoky dusk sky. The ash around the sapling is already turning to dark soil dotted with tiny green sprouts. No people.
entries.accent: glowing ember orange on charcoal black, with one fresh spring-green shoot

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, perfectly symmetrical, wide lens, as if seen from a hawk high above.
entries.subject: A ring of weathered standing stones seen from directly above, its inside divided like a wheel into four wedges of terrain: golden desert dunes, a white snowfield with blue ice, a temperate meadow with oak woods, and a dense green jungle with a winding river. At the centre lies one flat mossy altar stone with a gnarled wooden staff laid across it, and thin glowing lines of green life run from it outward along the ground into each wedge. Soft mist gathers where the terrains meet. No people.
entries.accent: earthy ochre, moss green and slate grey

entries.camera: Extreme wide low-angle shot from the ground looking up, the tiny silhouetted figure at the bottom edge, the night sky filling most of the frame.
entries.subject: On a bare hilltop under a clear night sky, a tiny silhouetted druid seen from behind raises one arm toward a vast constellation: a giant archer formed only of bright stars joined by thin glowing lines of light, bow drawn skyward, stretching across a third of the heavens. The Milky Way arches behind it and a few stars fall as slow streaks. Soft starlight rims the hilltop grass and the figure's cloak. No text, no star-chart lettering.
entries.accent: midnight blue with pale gold constellation lines

entries.camera: Telephoto side-on silhouette shot at eye level, 200mm look, compressing an enormous full moon behind the subject, shallow depth of field.
entries.subject: A colossal bear stands on a rocky ridge in profile, a pure black silhouette against a huge full moon, its fur edges glowing with silver light. Its shoulders and head are solid, while the hindquarters and tail are still dissolving into drifting silver mist, as if the shape is just now being completed. On the rock at its feet lie a folded travelling cloak and a gnarled wooden staff, left behind. Pine silhouettes below and thin clouds crossing the moon. The bear is calm and threatens no one.
entries.accent: cold silver-white moonlight on deep charcoal

entries.camera: Half-submerged over-under split shot, the lens straddling the waterline of a stormy sea, wide dome-port look.
entries.subject: Above the waterline, a lone silhouetted druid seen from behind stands on a black sea stack with one arm raised, while a towering ring-shaped wave of seawater spirals around the stack like a living crown, throwing sheets of spray, with a branching bolt of lightning in the thunderclouds above. Below the waterline the same ring continues as a calm whirl of bubbles and glowing kelp, a huge shadowy whale gliding past and silver fish spiralling in the current.
entries.accent: stormy teal with white sea foam

entries.camera: Eye-level over-the-shoulder shot, 35mm look, from behind the cropped hooded shoulder of a cloaked figure at the left edge of the frame, looking into a forest glade at dusk.
entries.subject: In the glade stands a tall carved wooden totem post, its surface carved with antlers, feathers and abstract non-legible swirls. A huge translucent spirit bear made of soft glowing light rises from it, rearing up calm and protective, its glow washing over the clearing. Gathered peacefully around the base are a stag, two wolves, a fox, hares and a few owls on low branches, all looking up at the spirit. In the foreground the figure's hand rests on a short gnarled staff.
entries.accent: deep forest green with a warm rose-gold spirit glow

entries.camera: Dutch-angle shot tilted about twenty degrees at eye level, wide lens, a small campfire in the foreground and the path rising behind it.
entries.subject: A small campfire in a moonlit summer forest glade, its flames burning in two halves: one side silver-white moonlight, the other a flickering black living shadow, each throwing its own light and darkness across the grass. Behind it a path of mossy stepping stones winds between leaning trees and rises into the air like a staircase of dreams, ending at an arch of flowering branches glowing warm gold. Fireflies, floating petals and glowing flower-bud lanterns drift through soft mist.
entries.accent: soft lavender-violet with silver mist and a few warm gold fey lights

entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at ground level, 100mm look, razor-thin depth of field, the lens inches from the moss.
entries.subject: A cluster of luminous mushrooms grows from a mossy fallen log, their caps splitting open to release glowing spores that rise into a perfect, slowly rotating halo ring of drifting motes. Above the mushrooms a cupped hand in a plain linen sleeve, cropped at the wrist, is held palm up inside the ring. Fine mycelium threads glow like tiny roots across the dark bark, and the blurred forest floor behind is dotted with more softly lit caps.
entries.accent: toxic lime-yellow spore glow on dark rotting brown
